events.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
events.description: Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations. After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas. Continue reading...

events.title: Czechs gather in big numbers to reject government's plan to overhaul funding of public media
events.description: Hundreds of thousands of people rallied in Prague against a government plan to overhaul funding for public broadcasters
events.ticker_label: 💥 Czechs gather in big numbers to reject government's plan to overhaul funding of public media

events.title: Cape Verde election could deliver first woman president since independence in 1975
events.description: Cape Verde has held a presidential election in which former Justice Minister Joana Rosa is challenging incumbent José Maria Neves

events.title: Africa is charting a different road to electric mobility with motorbikes and versatile 3-wheelers
events.description: In Africa, the electric vehicle transition is taking a different route from wealthier markets, with motorcycles and three-wheelers emerging as practical alternatives to passenger cars

events.title: Mayan ceremony in Guatemala honors Nobel winner Miguel Ángel Asturias
events.description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Rigoberta Menchú Tum attended the ritual.

events.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
events.description: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.

events.title: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years
events.description: In a quiet hospital corridor in Kyiv, staff and volunteers push carts carrying steaming pots of chicken soup, bread and buckwheat porridge to patients recently evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region.
events.ticker_label: 💥 ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years

events.title: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
events.description: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.

events.title: 'Purge'-masked suspect accused of killing college student at Halloween bash — before his sister helps nab him
events.description: Omar Perez's sister identified him using police photos and the family's Life360 app after the University of Colorado Boulder student's killing.
events.ticker_label: 💥 'Purge'-masked suspect accused of killing college student at Halloween bash — before his sister helps nab him

events.title: Harvard scientist pushes back on NASA chief over mystery space object: 'It's not an asteroid'
events.description: Avi Loeb challenges NASA's Jared Isaacman, arguing 1998 KY26 is not an asteroid and could be a lost Soviet spacecraft from a failed Mars mission.

events.title: Pentagon's former UFO investigator offers simple theory for mysterious jellyfish-shaped object on video
events.description: Video near Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson captured a jellyfish-shaped object with dangling strands, but a former Pentagon UFO investigator suggests its a kite.

events.title: Natalee Holloway's confessed killer caught trying to extort $250K from grieving mother in FBI sting video
events.description: Previously unseen FBI sting video captures Joran van der Sloot's attempt to extort Beth Holloway for information about her daughter, Natalee Holloway.

events.title: Sexual predator deported to Mexico hauled back to US for assault and murder of American mom
events.description: Miguel Angel Urbano-Vazquez was deported to Mexico after Sharon Van Gilder's 2002 murder but was later extradited and convicted decades later.

events.title: School investigating after viral video shows 10th grade girl punched, put in chokehold on Ohio school bus
events.description: Viral video shows a male student repeatedly punching, kicking and choking a 10th grade girl on an Ohio school bus as other students laughed.

events.title: Israel's political shake-up enters new phase as former PM plays kingmaker — and deadline looms
events.description: Benjamin Netanyahu called for unity, but Gadi Eisenkot canceled Likud talks after calling the outgoing prime minister's speech "delusional."
